weeks.title: Nvidia shoots up, what does the bond market say?
weeks.overview: Summaries on the biggest theme across all four regions this week.

north-america.equities: Bonds and stocks are a little too connected in this piece, so it'll be shown in both equities and macro this week. Nvidia shot up 31.5% upon Jensen's return as CEO, with the S&P 500 having its best day in 19 months. The NASDAQ recovered as well. The bonds market didn't buy it. The US 10 -year Treasury Yield did not move. When market sentiment is that stocks have more upside, money tends to go into the stock market and exit the safe, stable bond market. This pushes rates high with the sell-off. What happened here was that investors put money into stocks but did not sell their safe bonds.  This signals to me that it was more relief about Nvidia and the Ai trade, rather than an optimistic outlook on the economy.
